import pandas as pd
import os

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs('outputs', exist_ok=True)

# Read the input matrix
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Identify columns to analyze for missingness (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
# Assuming the first three columns are identifiers based on the task description
exclude_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = df[indicator_cols].isna().sum()
total_rows = len(df)
missing_rates = missing_counts / total_rows

# Create the missingness report
report_data = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_cols,
    'missing_count': missing_counts,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates
})

# Determine which indicators are kept (missing_rate <= 0.30)
report_data['kept'] = report_data['missing_rate'] <= 0.30

# Write the missingness report
report_file = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
report_data.to_csv(report_file, index=False)

# Select the matrix with only kept indicators
threshold = 0.30
kept_indicators = indicator_cols[report_data['kept'].values]

# Construct the dataframe with required columns
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]

# Write the selected matrix
selected_file = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
selected_df.to_csv(selected_file, index=False)

print(f"Report written to {report_file}")
print(f"Selected matrix written to {selected_file}")
print(f"Number of indicators kept: {len(kept_indicators)}")
</solution_file>
